tagline: Europe's leading specialist in shopping centers with exclusive continental European presence
hero_kpi_rationale: EBITDA is the primary indicator of operational performance in real estate, reflecting organic growth in rental revenues and cost management, driven here by strong leasing demand and positive rent reversions.
company_description: Klépierre is a European leader in shopping centers, specializing in retail real estate across continental Europe. The company manages a portfolio of shopping centers welcoming over 720 million visitors annually.

kpis.name: EBITDA Growth
kpis.explanation: Progression of EBITDA, which measures operational profitability.
kpis.description: EBITDA increased by 5.4% year-on-year, driven by higher net rental income and rigorous cost management.
kpis.signal: Solid EBITDA growth amid strong organic rental revenue increase and rigorous cost management.

kpis.name: Net Rental Income
kpis.explanation: Income from rents after deduction of non-recoverable property charges.
kpis.description: Net rental income rose 6.0% on a like-for-like basis, exceeding indexation by 320 basis points.
kpis.signal: Double-digit organic growth in net rental revenues exceeding indexation.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leasable space currently occupied by tenants.
kpis.description: Occupancy rate reached 96.2%, up 50 basis points year-on-year, reflecting effective asset management.
kpis.signal: Record occupancy rate reflecting strong tenant demand and effective asset management.

kpis.name: Rent Collection Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of billed rents actually collected.
kpis.description: Rent collection rate stands at 97.7%, up 120 basis points year-on-year, demonstrating tenant strength.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in cash-flow quality reflecting strong tenant base creditworthiness.

kpis.name: Tenant Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Growth in tenant sales within shopping centers.
kpis.description: Tenant sales increased by 3.9%, excluding disposals/acquisitions and Turkey, with footfall up 2%.
kpis.signal: Tenant sales growth indicating strong shopping center traffic and retail performance.

kpis.name: Portfolio Value Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in the market value of held real estate assets.
kpis.description: Portfolio value increased by 2% over six months on a like-for-like basis, reaching €19.874 billion.
kpis.signal: Recovery in asset values at constant perimeter reflecting improved market conditions.

kpis.name: Net Debt/EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Measures leverage relative to repayment capacity.
kpis.description: Net debt/EBITDA ratio stands at 7.3x, a historically low level, with average debt cost at 1.6%.
kpis.signal: Historically low leverage ratio providing significant financial capacity for growth investments.

kpis.name: EPRA NTA per Share
kpis.explanation: Net asset value per share under EPRA standards.
kpis.description: EPRA NTA per share amounts to €31.4, up 4.3% over six months.
kpis.signal: Shareholder value creation over six months demonstrating solid NAV per share growth.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of €0.95 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last three fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of €0.529 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last three fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 40.7% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares during the fiscal year. Indicates the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Five-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

ai_positioning.summary: Klépierre does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial releases.
evidence: No mention of AI in earnings release

Absence of AI use cases in leasing or footfall management
